alt: Poster: WPI inflation 11.39% in Sep 2026 (Aug 9.92%); Sensex 72,781.89 (-0.34%) and Nifty 50 22,622.70 (-0.44%) on 14 Oct 2026
text:
Wholesale inflation jumped to 11.39% in September, and benchmarks closed lower on Wednesday.

• WPI inflation rose to 11.39% in September 2026 from 9.92% in August, per Ministry of Commerce data as reported by The Tribune (ANI) and Telangana Today.
• Fuel and power inflation was 25.85% and manufactured products 9.76%, with food articles also named as a driver (same data).
• Sensex closed at 72,781.89, down 251.89 points (0.34%); Nifty 50 closed at 22,622.70, down 99.25 points (0.44%), per Kotak Neo and Liquide closing reports.
• Nifty IT rose 1.14% while financial services and pharma were among the weaker sectors (per Liquide).

Our view: higher input and fuel costs can matter for corporate margins and for interest-rate expectations, which is one reason markets watch these releases closely. But the index move was modest and followed a strong rally on Tuesday, so profit-booking may be as relevant as inflation. This is an interpretation of the data, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: when inflation prints move higher, how do you talk to clients about keeping their asset allocation and time horizon in focus?
